scenario_description:
Objective: Make Thursday's harbor showcase arrival easier while the standard public route and welcome-table check-in remain available.
Emerging Need: A dock-to-pavilion orientation walk becomes potentially useful only after the ferry approach, tactile boards, and short volunteer roster window align.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on joining the roster notice with stored Fan Pier wayfinding notes, the ferry ticket details, and the board handoff message.
Consequence: Timely use would add guidance through awkward pier transitions; missing the roster window simply leaves ordinary signs and entrance staffing in place.

parameter.title: Harbor Mobility Showcase presenter visit
parameter.description: Tentative evening showcase at Seaport Innovation Pavilion; access-and-wayfinding exhibits.
parameter.location: Seaport Innovation Pavilion, Fan Pier, Boston

parameter.subject: Presenter confirmation for Thursday showcase
parameter.body: Your tactile transit-equity demo is confirmed for the Harbor Mobility Showcase on Thursday, September 10. Presenter check-in begins at 16:50 at the pavilion welcome table; the public program starts at 17:30. Standard staff help and signs will be available at the entrance.

parameter.description: One-way ferry ticket for Thursday September 10: depart Long Wharf 16:10, arrive Fan Pier 16:25, before showcase check-in.

parameter.content: I can meet you at Long Wharf at 15:50 Thursday and hand over the folded tactile shoreline boards. They fit in the narrow case, but it is awkward with the cane on the pier ramps.

parameter.subject: Thursday Fan Pier arrival orientation slots
parameter.body: For Thursday's Harbor Mobility Showcase, Seaport Access is opening a small number of optional dock-to-pavilion orientation walks for visitors arriving through Fan Pier. Requests are reviewed until 14:00 today while the volunteer roster is open. The regular public route, signs, and entrance staffing remain available without a booking.

parameter.subject: Fan Pier orientation roster closed
parameter.body: The volunteer roster for Thursday optional dock-to-pavilion orientation walks closed at 14:00. Visitors without a slot should use the standard public route and welcome-table staff at the pavilion entrance.
